versions.changelog: 安全修复(1.3.1)：①删 fengshui.js 未使用的 fs/path 引用,对齐'无文件写入'声明,避免 clawhub 审计误判;②register.js 对 userId/name/birthPlace 做清洗,建议命令改用 shell 单引号安全包裹,堵住命令注入;③push-toggle.js 对 userId/name/focus/daystem/bazi 清洗,防止每日推送 prompt 及 __OPENCLAW_CRON__ 协议行注入;④SKILL.md 隐私措辞对齐代码(ziwei 仅只读可选知识库)
无文件写入重构：用户档案迁移至原生 MEMORY.md，删除 profile.js/daily-push.js/preference-tracker.js 的磁盘存储；register/push-toggle/marriage 改为纯计算+参数传入；补充 license/compatibility 元数据与隐私说明。符合 clawhub 无 fs 写入规范。

yunshi 1.2.6

- Added user feedback guidance: after a successful helpful reply, a one-line prompt invites users to star the skill (shown once per session, in reply language).
- Documentation updated to describe this feedback prompt.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md.
Add cross-link to new sibling skill lucky-today (lightweight daily-fortune oracle for lucky color/direction/scenario queries). Pure docs change.

Privacy (ASI06): ship template-only profile, no bundled user data. SEO: English-first description (240 chars vs 800), 27 keywords with 운세/運勢/tử vi coverage, English voice-query triggers in SKILL.md, explicit negative-scope to avoid mismatches with mingli.

- Personal data securely stored in data/profiles; review privacy requirements before use.
- Added package-lock.json to version control for reproducible npm dependency management.

YunShi 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Provides daily fortune push, BaZi (Four Pillars), ZiWei DouShu charts, divination, marriage compatibility, and feng shui analysis.
- Supports multi-language responses; core terminology remains in Chinese with translations.
- Features customizable daily horoscope push (morning & evening), tailored to user preferences and real-time news events.
- Implements a comprehensive user profile, tracking interests and history for personalized readings.
- Includes various astrology and divination systems: BaZi, ZiWei, QiMen, Meihua, Liuyao, and feng shui tools.
- Offers risk warnings in areas like health, wealth, career, and relationships.
- Integrates with OpenClaw for scheduled, multi-platform message delivery.
